style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal #141414 for moody food shots, warm cream #FDF6E6 for info and spec panels, and muted warm sand #F2C879 for section and closing panels; one flat background per shot, never mixed within a shot
style.direction: warm dark-premium Chinese bakery gift commerce
style.iconSystem: thin-line minimal dining icons in #E8A33D only, single stroke weight, no filled, no multicolor, no detailed illustration
style.lightingSystem: warm directional light around 4200K from the upper left with gentle gradient falloff, deep soft shadows and a soft contact shadow always grounding the food, appetizing flaky crust texture and glossy egg-wash sheen, never harsh, never plastic
style.lockText: {style_lock} consistent warm dark-premium Chinese bakery visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #141414, warm cream panel #FDF6E6, muted warm sand #F2C879 and one warm amber accent #E8A33D, with charcoal brown text #2B2724 on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark ones; warm directional lighting around 4200K from the upper left with gentle gradient falloff and soft contact shadows that always ground the food; appetizing flaky crust texture with a glossy egg-wash sheen, never plastic; one modern geometric sans-serif for all headline and label text; consistent thin-line minimal dining icons in #E8A33D; consistent rounded rectangular panels and pill labels; clean high-end food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food texture, no background repetition.
style.presentationRules: consistent product scale and stable placement across the set, pastries always shown fresh with a glossy egg-wash sheen, black sesame scattered on top, and at least one piece broken or cut open to reveal many flaky layers and a whole salted egg yolk
style.surfaceSystem: matte dark ceramic plate #1A1A1A, light wood board #D8B888, dark navy linen #232A3A, dark brown textured cloth #3B2A20, plain matte cream board #F7EFE0
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif with bold weight for all headline and label text, charcoal brown #2B2724 on light backgrounds or #FFFFFF on dark backgrounds
